subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic busy-session acknowledgement by default, make it opt-in/configurable, and which portable cancel/new-session actions plus busy reason fields should be part of that contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding visible status text, configuration, and cross-channel actions changes product UX and compatibility expectations across messaging surfaces.

options.title: Default Safe Busy Notice
options.body: Add a default-on, non-destructive scripted busy notice with stable reason metadata, and leave cancel/new-session actions behind channel-safe command guidance or later config.

options.title: Opt-In Configurable Busy Ack
options.body: Add busy acknowledgement only behind a new messages.queue option so existing deployments keep the current silent queue/typing behavior until operators enable it.

options.title: Defer To Channels
options.body: Keep core enqueue behavior unchanged and let channel/plugin owners implement local busy UX, accepting inconsistent behavior across channels.

recommendation.title: Default Safe Busy Notice
recommendation.body: Add a default-on, non-destructive scripted busy notice with stable reason metadata, and leave cancel/new-session actions behind channel-safe command guidance or later config.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for queue policy and queued-followup behavior points to steipete, and the decision would change that shared reply path.
